It's a Vector Decision Model.

drafts.text:
GPT-6.2 Sol is rolling out across Copilot Chat, Cowork, Copilot Studio, and Copilot in Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Astra is landing in Cowork and Copilot Studio.

Before you switch your Copilot Studio agent to the new model, rerun your test questions.

Upgrade the model. Keep the evals.

drafts.rides: @mustafasuleyman "We are crossing a threshold" (301K) + your own agent spending ceiling post (3.1K) + @OpenAI GPT-6 Cyber patches for review (810K)
drafts.text:
Mustafa Suleyman: we're crossing a threshold, and safety and alignment work is the only thing that matters.

Inside a company, a lot of that work looks boring.

A spending cap per agent. An approval step before it acts. A named person who owns it.

Boring controls are how powerful agents get to production.
drafts.video_tip: Vertical 8s: you stamp three sticky notes onto a monitor one by one: 'CAP', 'APPROVE', 'OWNER'. Caption: 'Safety, enterprise edition.'

drafts.rides: @OpenAI protein design preprint (1.56M) + amateur astronomers with Codex and Astra (363K) + @gdb no bio-specific model (114K)
drafts.text:
OpenAI says GPT-6 models designed new protein shapes and sequences with reasoning and code, without calling specialized biology models.

Same week, two amateur astronomers used Codex and Astra to search public data for signals of planets around distant stars.

General model + code + a curious person.

That's the recipe for most good agents I've built too.
drafts.video_tip: Vertical 10s: three items slide onto a desk one at a time, a laptop, a notebook of code, and a mug that says 'curious'. Caption: 'The whole recipe.'

drafts.text:
This week AI helped pin the matrix multiplication exponent at exactly 9/4.

Also this week, I asked it to fix one Power Automate expression and it added three closing parentheses.

AI for science is incredible. AI for formulas still needs a code review.
drafts.video_tip: Vertical 8s: split screen, left a chalkboard with '9/4' circled, right you squinting at an expression with too many brackets. Caption: 'Same week.'

drafts.text:
ChatGPT's pitch for dot: it handles the busywork so you can make the creative calls.

That's the bar for every assistant, Copilot included.

My test is simple. At the end of the week, did it give me back an hour? Or did it give me a new tab to babysit?
